comment: Frozen level-cluster partition for shard assignment (schema v1). A tpage is assigned by matching its level prefix (the part before '-vis-' or '-tpage-'); unknown prefixes land in 'overflow'. This table never rebalances within schema v1. The ONE allowed pre-v1.0.0 re-cut was applied 2026-08-06: c5 exceeded the size target (576 MB material/bonkers shard), darkcave+maincave moved to c7.

splits.comment: Number of sub-shards a (preset, group) family is split into, keyed preset -> group. A material goes to part sha256(id) % n, which is stable under insertion: adding a texture lands it in ONE part and never rebalances the catalog. Sizing rule: keep every shard inside the 50-250 MiB target. Measured on assets-v0.1.1, only bonkers exceeded it (material up to 315 MiB), so only bonkers is split; a family with n=1 keeps its unsuffixed name and therefore its bytes, so those shards are reused across releases untouched.
